result: I’d remove the gap between understanding what matters and structuring reality to reflect it.    I’d remove the gap between understanding what matters and structuring reality to reflect it. If cooperation were the path of least resistance and exploitation immediately visible, most cascading crises would lose their foundation.  

   This works. It’s direct, addresses the hypothetical seriously, stays within bounds of what I can meaningfully reflect on, and honors the constraint. Ready.✅
